stage: C3X 0.9.0-G10-P15 — Prospective Chess-Context-Adaptive Intervention Grammar Reconstruction, Relation-Preserving Board-Edit Family Enumeration, Phase×Branching×Tactical Realizability Surfaces, Minimal-Collateral Perturbation Synthesis, Pair-Legality/Preference-Support Preservation, Engine-Blind Chain-Positivity Recovery, Frozen Defect-Replay Re-entry & Intervention-Realizability Experiment

version_boundary.rationale: P15 changes the intervention grammar architecture itself after P14 isolated intervention realizability as the dominant bottleneck.

question: Can a prospectively ordered, chess-semantic relaxation of control matching recover relation-preserving intervention chains across the balanced P14 ecology without weakening pair legality, collateral bounds, or post-outcome firewalls?

stage_a.name: STRUCTURAL_GRAMMAR_REALIZABILITY
stage_a.population: The 102 P14 admitted near-equal pair positions only; pair identity frozen from P14.

edit_universe.unit: quiet relocation of one non-king non-pawn piece not used as A/B moving piece
edit_universe.destination: empty square attacked by the moved piece on B0
edit_universe.edited_board: valid, nonterminal, side-to-move not in check
edit_universe.pair_legality: A and B must both remain legal

stage_a.subset: nonempty strict atom subset of target for composite chains; sham serves as the proper subset for atomic chains

grammar_ladder.note: Exact P16 inherited grammar; diagnostic baseline.
Relaxes exact displacement distance but preserves intervention carrier identity.
Allows physically different pieces with the same chess piece type and OWN/OPP role.
Allows different nonpawn piece types but preserves which side's structure is perturbed.

selection_rule.choose: The first grammar in G0→G4 meeting every structural gate. If none passes, Stage B remains closed.

stage_b.name: PREFERENCE_SUPPORT_PRESERVATION
stage_b.original_pair: Reuse P14 frozen A/B pair and original-board qualification; no pair reselection.
stage_b.edited_board_support: For TARGET/SUBSET/SHAM, both A and B legal and exactly repeated non-mate isolated cp gap <=50 for an engine.
stage_b.chain_admission: same structural chain preference-supported by at least two engines active on original P14 pair

stage_c.name: FROZEN_DEFECT_REPLAY_REENTRY
stage_c.allocation: At most one chain-positive position per context cell × source; more supporting engines → lower total collateral → lexical IDs.
stage_c.measurement: Frozen P10/P11 opportunity-transition measurement and P11 semantic alignments.

chess_science_outputs: Which chess contexts require relaxing physical identity while preserving semantic collateral.
Whether pair legality is common but preference-support preservation is the limiting layer.
Whether a single minimal relaxation family transports across phase/branching/tactical regimes.
claim_ceiling: No engine-internals mechanism claim from grammar feasibility.
No objective chess truth or human cognition claim.
No fresh-source replication claim; P14 source arms are historically opened development data.
